sources.entry: Saber - Cross platform stylus and text notetaking app. Supports image and pdf imports, can sync. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/saber/id1671523739?platform=mac) [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/adil192/saber)

summary.name: Saber
summary.one_liner: Saber is a handwriting-focused notes app that supports stylus and text notetaking and syncs notes across devices with encryption.
use_cases: taking handwritten notes with a stylus
syncing notes across phone, tablet and computer
summary.what_it_does: Saber is a notes app built around handwriting, supporting both stylus and text notetaking. Notes can be synced and edited across phones, tablets and computers. According to the listing, image and PDF imports are supported. Notes are described as encrypted and stored so that not even the server can read them. Organization is done through unlimited nested folders and a home screen showing recent notes. Its highlighter is designed not to overlap or change color on re-stroke and renders beneath the text, and dark mode darkens the notes themselves as well as the UI.
notable: Notes encrypted so the sync server cannot read them
Highlighter that does not overlap or change color and renders under text
Dark mode that also darkens the note content
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page
Platform list is not fully stated on the page; only phone, tablet, computer and the App Store Mac listing are mentioned
